const int MOD2 = 1000000007;

vector<int> buckets[10];
int bucketSums[10], result, totalNodes;

inline int mod1(ll x) {
    return ((x % MOD1) + MOD1) % MOD1;
}

void precompute(int depth, ll prefix) {
    ++counter;
    buckets[depth].push_back(mod1(counter - prefix));
    if (depth == 6) return;
    for (int digit = 0; digit <= 9; ++digit) {
        precompute(depth + 1, prefix * 10 + digit);
    }

void query(int depth, ll currentNum) {
    if (currentNum > n) return;
    
    if (depth >= 1) {
        if (currentNum * B > n / 10 && (currentNum + 1) * B - 1 <= n) {
            int multiplier = 1;

            }
            counter += totalNodes;
            return;

    }
    
    for (int digit = (depth == 0); digit <= 9; ++digit) {
        query(depth + 1, currentNum * 10 + digit);
    }

    cin.tie(nullptr);
    
    cin >> n;

    for (int i = 0; i <= 6; ++i) {
